evidence.property_proven: Disposable Postgres with every migration and emulated Supabase default privileges; the real helper src/purchase-intent-db.mjs over a supabase-js-shaped rpc adapter (one bound statement per call). Immutability: every listed critical field and every once-set value is refused by the trigger (also by the owner), values are never cleared, late only false->true; the stored hash equals the P4A hash of the stored data and tampered data cannot build. Transitions: build, submit, confirm, fail, late-confirm, cancel and expire each act once with idempotent exact retries and fail-closed different values; OPEN->SUBMITTED, terminal->OPEN, SUBMITTED->EXPIRED and FAILED->CONFIRMED without late are refused by the trigger; SUBMITTED is never cancelled or expired. Expiry at exactly now() and build_deadline at exactly now() refuse, now()+1 us works; a stale active intent is closed when its wallet creates a new one. Access: RLS on, anon/authenticated 42501 on every table operation and function, service_role reads and calls exactly the eight functions, cannot write directly, nobody deletes; SECURITY DEFINER with pinned search_path, no EXECUTE/format()/DELETE in any body. Concurrency: six races of 40 independent connections, each held in an open transaction at an advisory-lock barrier that is released only after the database reports 40 waiting backends with 40 distinct PIDs: one active intent per wallet, one row per idempotency key (no last write wins), one build, one transaction hash, one owner per transaction hash, idempotent confirmations, at most one cover id per intent and one intent per cover id in a mixed late/normal race.

evidence.property_proven: Behaviourally, against the read-only verifier with two offline readers. Positive: a SYNTHETIC receipt constructed from the verified ABI (event topics and view selectors recomputed from the source signatures, real pinned runtimes for Broker, Cover proxy and implementation) verifies with every one of 21 checks passed; amount equal to or above the intent and a zero refund are accepted. Negative, each with its own status: missing / pending / reverted transaction, receipt not belonging to the transaction, wrong chain (node and transaction), sender, Broker target, value, calldata hash (incl. an otherwise valid swapped input), selector and non-canonical encoding, decoder policy for owner / product / amount / period / maxPremium / commission / proof-of-loss / coverId, CoverBought missing / foreign emitter / duplicate / wrong product / member / originalCoverId, NFT mint missing / foreign / not a mint / other recipient / other token id, Cover state product / asset / amount below intent / period / start / not original / ownerOf / metadata, third-party USDC payout, Broker / proxy / implementation code and implementation slot drift at the receipt block, too few confirmations (incl. the lower head of two readers), not finalized, zero confirmations refused, block hash differing from the block at that number. Reader B disagreeing on transaction, receipt, logs, block, storage, code, state or chain fails closed in both directions; both readers see the same reads; one reader passed twice is refused; a failure of either reader on any method is TEMPORARY_RPC_FAILURE. Client receipt / logs / cover id / block / from / to / data / value / status are refused and never read. Deterministic over repeated runs. Real mainnet receipt of block 26219867 (two-provider capture, replayed offline): structural relationship of transaction, receipt, block, CoverBought(5645, 5645, 9301, 97), NFT mint, USDC flows and Cover state; the verifier rejects it for exactly commission ratio, commission destination and proof-of-loss CID (never verified). No send, sign, wallet, network, DB or environment code; only eight read methods; no runtime importer; no builder import.
